title: Accounting practice platform
subtitle: Multi-tenant CRM for Greek accounting firms
problem: Greek accounting practices juggle client records, documents, recurring statutory deadlines, and half a dozen government portals. I built the system that holds all of it in one place — a multi-tenant platform where each firm's data, credentials, and users are strictly isolated.
hardPart: Not the CRUD — it was that every firm on the platform stores other people's tax credentials. That forced encrypted credential storage with audited, just-in-time reveal; tenant scoping enforced on every query rather than trusted at the UI; role-based access down to individual fields; and an append-only audit trail. The schema moves through [[ B5 — N ]] forward-only migrations so a deploy never requires downtime, and [[ B5 — N ]] tests run on every change.
